products.title: Mayfield pleated satin abaya
products.details: Closed abaya with a round neck and concealed front zip. Knife-pleated sleeves from the elbow. Fully lined so it is opaque without a slip. Two hidden side pockets.

products.title: Embroidered occasion abaya
products.details: Heavy crepe abaya with tonal embroidery across the back yoke and cuffs. Open front with a hidden popper at the chest. Made for Eid, weddings and evenings.

products.title: Hallway open abaya
products.details: Fluid open abaya in soft crepe with wide sleeves. Wear it over a lined maxi or a co-ord. Falls to the ankle in your length.

products.title: Tonal embroidered cuff abaya
products.details: Closed abaya with a fine embroidered band at each cuff. A quiet everyday piece that dresses up.

products.title: Tooting lined maxi dress
products.details: Long-sleeve maxi with a high round neck, fully lined. Wear it alone or under an open abaya.

products.title: Satin maxi dress
products.details: Matte satin maxi with long sleeves and a soft drape. Fully lined.

products.title: Linen co-ord set
products.details: Long tunic with side splits and wide-leg trousers with an elasticated back. Washed linen, softer with every wear.

products.title: Open kimono abaya
products.details: Lightweight kimono-sleeve open abaya to layer over a dress or co-ord.

products.title: Modal hijab
products.details: Soft, breathable modal that holds without slipping. 70 × 180 cm.

products.title: Hijab bundle, five colours
products.details: Sage, dusty pink, cream, plum and charcoal in modal, jersey and chiffon. Folded and gift-wrapped.

products.title: Two-piece prayer set
products.details: Attached-hijab top and a full skirt in soft jersey. Cuffed sleeves for wudu. Folds into its own pouch.

products.title: Prayer abaya
products.details: One-piece jersey abaya with a built-in hood and cuffed sleeves. Easy over everyday clothes.
